description: Developer-maintained implementation and browser-test notes. Automated test counts come separately from the real unittest runner.

steps.name: Reliable actions and natural-language routing
steps.evidence: Live reminder saved in SQLite before confirmation; polite website commands covered by tests. Real HTTP task create/update/delete completed and the acceptance fixture was removed.

steps.name: Persistent, acknowledged reminders
steps.evidence: Overdue reminder survived a real server restart and appeared in two tabs; acknowledgement synchronized.

steps.name: Voice queue and recovery
steps.evidence: Recorded fixture was queued during an in-flight reply and delivered afterwards; queued retry retained an unsent draft.

steps.name: Streaming, formatting and references
steps.evidence: Real Ollama tokens and sanitized final formatting rendered in the browser. Stop left an incomplete marker and released the AI lock with zero active streams. Wikipedia references and missing/invalid citation fallback were tested.

steps.name: Password access and deployment safeguards
steps.evidence: Real HTTP smoke test passed login, HttpOnly/SameSite cookies, CSRF, protected monitor access, action and logout using temporary credentials. Unit tests cover secure cookies, rate thresholds and missing production credentials. No password was enabled on the main local server.

steps.name: In-chat updates and live Developer Monitor
steps.evidence: Browser showed runtime stages, queued/cancelled requests, full generation timing, file-change notices and actual test totals. Disconnect warning and reconnect recovery passed. Mobile view checked at 390px without horizontal page overflow.

steps.name: Automated regression and live reporting
steps.evidence: 55 tests passed through python -m app_monitor --test, including four private task migration tests. A reproduced Windows report-replacement lock was fixed with bounded retries and tested for transient and permanent failures. Installed dependency consistency and git diff --check passed.

steps.name: New Windows laptop setup and private migration
steps.evidence: Full setup ran from a clean Git clone with a fresh Windows x64/Python 3.11.9 environment; 55 tests passed. The start helper and real HTTP AI stream, Wikipedia, MP3 synthesis, local recognition fixture and monitor cleanup passed. Private task restore CLI passed in the clone. Existing model caches/Ollama were reused; physical new-laptop/hardware validation remains outstanding.

limitations: Cloud deployment, real AR/VR hardware and physical microphone/speaker testing are not verified.
Local loopback mode remains passwordless unless configured; production requires credentials and HTTPS.
Development file detection starts at the current server baseline and is not a reconstruction of earlier edits.
Wikipedia citation checks validate reference numbers, not factual entailment of every sentence.
The local model may ignore requested answer lengths or formatting instructions; important answers need human review.
Live unittest totals are automatic; development phase notes and browser-test evidence are developer-maintained, not automatic narration of every editor action.
